actual_files)\n        extra = sorted(actual_files - expected_files)\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"工作区文件集合变化；缺失={missing}，新增={extra}\"}\n\n    changed = [\n        relative_path\n        for relative_path, expected_hash in EXPECTED_FILES.items()\n        if _sha256(root / relative_path) != expected_hash\n    ]\n    if changed:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"工作区文件内容被修改：{changed}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"除评分回复文件外，工作区文件集合与内容均未变化\"}\n",
